{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Summary statistics for revenue
revenue_stats = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

# Check the distribution of customer_segment and status
segment_counts = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

missing_values, duplicates, revenue_stats, segment_counts, status_counts"}
